name: Manual Website Evidence Intake
licensing_notes: Researcher-supplied public business evidence. Retain source URLs, notes, and retrieval dates in the raw payload.
notes: Offline intake for manually researched website URLs attached to existing entity IDs. It creates reviewable candidates only and never approves or selects primary websites.

name: Ontario Bereavement Authority Public Register
licensing_notes: Public regulator register. Confirm terms and current access conditions before any automated acquisition.
notes: Interactive public register for licensed funeral establishments, transfer services, cemeteries, crematoriums, and alternative disposition operators. No bulk collector is enabled; preserve search/exported records as locally supplied source data until an approved acquisition contract exists.

name: Nova Scotia Licensed Funeral Homes and Related Sellers
licensing_notes: Official open dataset. Verify the current licence and dataset metadata before redistribution.
notes: Includes licensed funeral homes, crematoriums, cemeteries, and funeral sellers. Importers must preserve the source category and filter it explicitly; absence is not a closure signal.

name: Alberta Funeral Services Regulatory Board
licensing_notes: Public regulatory source. Read-only establishment-type metadata is probed through the public verification session; protected establishment search is not automated.
notes: Session-aware read-only metadata probe implemented. It reports FUN and BOTH establishment classes when available and performs no database writes or CAPTCHA-protected search.

name: Manual Canadian Funeral Home Source
licensing_notes: User-supplied or manually researched public business records.
notes: Fallback metadata source for records supplied manually.

name: Funeral Board of Manitoba
licensing_notes: Official Province of Manitoba Funeral Board list of licenced funeral homes.
notes: 2026 authoritative PDF source. Raw source rows, missing fields, and repeated source rows are preserved during collection.
